rationale: A net-cash EAF rebar group at a filed FY2025 operating loss with the filed H1-2026 spread already recovering is valued on the normalized mid-cycle FCFF path, not on trough optics.

hypotheses.statement: Mid-cycle FCFF of ~42 KRW bn is recoverable as the filed H1-2026 rebar-scrap spread (823-480 thousand KRW/ton) holds and YK Steel utilization normalizes from the filed 49%
causal_chain: domestic rebar price vs scrap spread
kill_conditions: rebar realized price falls back below 750 thousand KRW/ton for two consecutive halves
YK Steel rolling utilization stays below 50% through FY2027

context_strength_linkage.not_applicable_reason: No non-obvious environment-to-strength connection is observable in the collected evidence beyond the declared mid-cycle thesis.
